Streaming chat completion via Ollama local provider with SSE chunks

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to 3\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"ollama/qwen2:0.5b\",\"stream\":true}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chatStream(req: _req)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
print(result)
```
